field_mappings.current_fact: The collector samples ROS time in its timer path and consumes a JSON trigger without a ROS header.
field_mappings.proposed_capture: At first valid-trigger consumption, read positive ROS time; pin once. If zero/unavailable/invalid, leave unpinned and send no action while the existing steady deadline runs.
field_mappings.identity_and_invalidation: Pinned to the attempt's goal intent, lifecycle/config identity, map identity, and barrier event context. Clock rollback or any identity/context invalidation terminates the attempt.

field_mappings.current_fact: The collector holds goal arguments and config_hash; lifecycle message exposes tuple and state; the Run005 profile supplies map identity.
field_mappings.proposed_capture: Pin goal intent, active lifecycle/config identity, map identity, and barrier revision/event context at Phase A admission. No path fields are required yet.

field_mappings.identity_and_invalidation: At most one planner action per attempt. UUID belongs to ComputePathToPose and is not equated with the NavigateToPose UUID.

field_mappings.current_fact: Current collector stores the successful map-frame result path; the ROS action result does not supply Architecture path_sequence as an assumed field.
field_mappings.proposed_capture: After matched SUCCEEDED result only, copy immutable path; admission adapter increments path_sequence and records steady receipt time.
field_mappings.identity_and_invalidation: Bind to exact planner request/action goal, attempt goal intent, lifecycle/config identity, and map identity. Invalidate on expiry at existing steady campaign deadline or earlier goal end, lifecycle/config/map change, path replacement, cancel/preemption, or attempt failure.

field_mappings.current_fact: _set increments sequence; ordinary monotonic refresh does not. Message carries the lifecycle tuple and sequence but no source_instance_id; node publishes on /mecanum/safety_lifecycle_state.
field_mappings.proposed_capture: Pin sequence with episode_generation/reset_epoch/runtime_generation and an independently approved, verified publisher/source binding. Do not use header.stamp or barrier_stamp as the revision.
field_mappings.identity_and_invalidation: Counter regression, tuple change, source change, or unverifiable correspondence fails closed; sequence/event change-and-return still invalidates.
evidence_to_check: publisher endpoint/source binding selected by future authority

field_mappings.current_source: Run005 _Collector._tick callbacks _scan/_odom/_lifecycle/_receipt; Observation Input Contract V3
field_mappings.current_fact: The collector retains latest received records and timestamps; V3 requires exact lifecycle identity, cutoff ordering, provenance, and immutable typed inputs at its boundary.
field_mappings.proposed_capture: At acquisition, pin t_vector and exact scan, odometry, receipt, lifecycle, returned-path and identity records eligible at that cutoff; later inputs cannot replace them.
field_mappings.identity_and_invalidation: Exact lifecycle tuple/config/map/path/barrier context; post-cutoff or future records reject. Pending snapshot replacement is forbidden.
evidence_to_check: original record stamps and steady receipt times

field_mappings.current_fact: The current transform helper transforms a selected map path pose to base_link; Safety source bounds filtered odometry age at 250000000 ns, but current V3 contract leaves LocalReference provider/freshness unselected.
field_mappings.proposed_capture: Set t_tf equal to the pinned odometry record's exact ROS stamp. Deep-copy transform input; preserve path and measurement timestamps.
field_mappings.identity_and_invalidation: Require matched path context, odometry identity, frames, lifecycle/map/barrier context, and successful exact lookup. A lookup exception cannot commit.

field_mappings.current_fact: The current source value 250000000 ns applies to filtered odometry age only; it does not define TF publisher freshness or LocalReference age.
field_mappings.proposed_capture: After lookup/transform, re-read ROS time as t_commit and re-read steady time and active identity/context. Proposed sim-only bound: 0 <= t_commit - t_tf <= pinned filtered_odometry_max_age_ns (250000000 ns). Missing/invalid value rejects.
field_mappings.identity_and_invalidation: Recheck deadline, age, cutoff order, generation/epoch, barrier revision/source, path identity, and all existing admission predicates immediately before commit. Rollback latches terminal failure.
